jet_bell_mouths.edge: 90 degrees, on the slot side (|X| 10.2) at Z-73.6: the jets' top is where it was
jet_bell_mouths.note: Measured across X at Y22.2. P22 prints on its back face, so this profile lies in every layer; the wall-thickness ray cast leaves this band out.

outlet.jets: Horizontal, one each side of the nozzle, between the channel floor (Z-76.65) and the flat bottom of the duct-to-slot wall (Z-73.6), whose duct side is rounded into a bell-mouth (r 1.4); the floor under them is solid, so no air blows down at the bed.
outlet.note: Open area in planes across the jets (|X| 10.3-11.5), inside P22's outer profile. The revision-41 review's first figure (41.8 mm2 released) also counted open air under P22's heel; this one doesn't.

x+18.screw: M3x8 ISO 7380 button head on the cheek's front face

inserts.insert: M3 x 4, OD 4.2 (modelled at the Ø4.0 hole it melts into)

screws.upper: M3x18 through P20's wings, tip at Y-17.8, through the whole insert
screws.lower: M3x14 from behind the board, tip at Y-18.25, through the whole insert

hall_lead_path.note: The leads end 0.4 mm in front of P02. Released, P02's strip under the motor bore and the first revision-41 P24 (its groove stopped at Y-17.2) closed the way to the EBB42.

p02.note: The v26 servo envelope is 22.96 mm long, 0.16 mm over TowerPro's 22.8 mm; it overlaps each end of the recess by 0.03 mm. The two ear screws are unchanged; the only other change to P02 is the hall leads' groove under the motor.

p03.note: The released pockets' inner walls were 0.2 mm from P03's centre slot and the Ø6×4 floors 0.27 mm. In revision 41 the 6 mm magnets' pockets open into the slot wherever the wall would be under 0.6 mm; the Ø6×4 floor is 0.5 mm at the three +X discs at Z 30.5, 5.5 and -2.0 (P03's wall is 4.3 mm thick there, with carriage parts right behind it). The thinnest wall left in every variant is P03's own notch above the upper pockets.

carriage_internal.checked: Every pair of carriage parts and fasteners: the revision-31 core with the new P02, P03 and 15x5x3 magnets, the MG90D envelope, P20-P24, cable, Beacon, EBB42, all fasteners. P02 against the servo envelope is the snug recess, reported under p02.
carriage_internal.note: Revision 40 checked the core as one body. Split here so P02, P03 and the magnets could be swapped, its own fasteners show their modelled overlaps (screws in inserts and self-tapping holes); each matches the same pair with the released P02, P03 and receiver magnets.

frame_source.note: Nominal frame, panels and door from 01_Voron24_350_Frame_and_Enclosure as world bounding boxes (conservative for the extrusion profiles). No Z drives, bed supports or bed wiring are modeled.

hardware.changed: P24: the four M3 x 4 heat-set inserts (OD 4.2) go in Ø4.0 pockets at Y-22.6..-18.6, pressed in from the side that faces P02; the upper EBB42 screws through P20's wings stay M3x18, now through the whole insert, and the lower ones become M3x14 (were M3x12). P21: its saddle rises 0.62 mm to the top plane, so the two P24-to-P21 inserts sit 0.62 mm under the new face, at the bottom of a Ø4.7 counterbore; the same M3x8 screws reach them. P22 to P01: 2x M3x8 ISO 7380 button heads on the cheeks' front faces (were M3x10 socket heads in counterbores), into the same inserts in P01's bosses. P03: the magnets of the chosen variant.
hardware.unchanged: Everything else, including P20, P21 and P02's screws and inserts.

limitations: Rigid CAD and sampled straight paths. Airflow is simulated separately (cfd_cpap_r41.py, verification_cfd_cpap_r41.json), not measured.
P02's recess is sized for TowerPro's MG90D body, 12.2 x 22.8 mm; a servo that measures differently needs SERVO_POCKET in r41_parts.py changed.
Insert pull-out, printed-part creep and magnet glue joints are not qualified.
